article_title: Neonatal Training across Union of European Medical Specialists Member Countries: A Survey from the Next Generation of Neonatologists.
citation: Williams Emma, Dassios Theodore, Alonso-Ojembarrena Almudena, Roehr Charles C., Been Jasper V., Pieter de Boode Willem, Jost Kerstin. (2025). Neonatal Training across Union of European Medical Specialists Member Countries: A Survey from the Next Generation of Neonatologists. Neonatology. https://doi.org/10.1159/000547673
title: Structured online survey of neonatal trainees across UEMS member countries on pulmonology training
description: A structured online questionnaire distributed via the ESPR newsletter and targeted national neonatology societies from 35 full and associate member countries of the UEMS between December 2023 and June 2024. It collected demographic information, training description, research activity, and self-rated confidence (1–5) and supervision-requirement levels for manual tasks and clinical decision-making, plus readiness to become a consultant on a 1–10 scale. One hundred and eight individual responses from 24 countries were received; 105 were analysed.
requirements: Distribution via ESPR newsletter and national neonatology societies
Eligibility restricted to current NST or those who completed training within the last 3 years
constraints: Risk of selection bias as the survey was not mandatory
Distribution through the ESPR introduced bias toward trainees from more academically inclined institutions
target_learners: Junior consultants who completed training within the last 3 years
target_learning_goals: Assessment of training experiences and confidence in pulmonology-related skills
